text: Maestro Remote 是面向 DSH Web 的远程访问插件，通过 Cordis 补丁注册隧道、代理和设置界面。它支持启动 Cloudflare quick 或 named 隧道、通过 PIN 保护公网入口、按需开启局域网 PIN，并在设置页管理隧道和 PIN。适合需要从手机或其他设备连接 DSH 会话的用户；需要 Node.js 22.19+ 或 24+，并由 cloudflared 提供隧道连接。

Maestro Remote lets DSH Web users connect remotely through Cloudflare tunnels. Its web settings manage the tunnel and PIN access, with an optional separate LAN PIN. For users connecting to DSH from another device; requires Node.js 22.19+ or 24+.
想从手机访问运行在电脑上的 DSH 会话。
如何给 DSH Web 开一个远程连接入口？
让 DSH 通过 Cloudflare 隧道在外网可访问。
我想给远程访问加 PIN 登录保护。
能不能在局域网里用 PIN 控制其他设备的访问？
我需要在网页设置里启动或停止远程隧道。
I want to reach my DSH session from my phone while away from home.
Add a PIN-protected tunnel so I can access DSH Web remotely.
Maestro Remote 的功能「远程隧道」：从设置界面启动或停止 quick 或 named Cloudflare 隧道，并显示隧道状态。quick 隧道在本机解析 cloudflared 后连接到代理端口。
Maestro Remote 的功能「PIN 访问控制」：公网隧道入口要求 PIN 登录，并可从设置界面查看或轮换公网 PIN；登录凭据以 cookie 保存。
Maestro Remote 的功能「局域网代理」：可配置本地代理端口并选择是否启用独立 LAN PIN，让同一局域网设备连接 DSH Web。
远程隧道会使用 cloudflared；本地设置保存在 DSH_HOME。见 src/host/tunnel.ts:585、src/host/config-store.ts:36。

@ddtcorex/dsh-maestro-remote README · What it provides：- **Tunnel lifecycle** (`maestroTunnel` service): start/stop/status of a cloudflared
  quick tunnel or a named tunnel with a single ingress to the PIN-gated remote proxy, which
  exempts `/hooks/gitlab-mr` and `/hooks/gitlab-mr/trigger` from the PIN so GitLab can post
  webhooks; auto-restore of a previously running named tunnel on boot.
- **Remote proxy**: request handler for the tunnel target with PIN auth
  (constant-time comparison), reloadable config.
- **cloudflared fetcher**: resolves the binary from PATH or installs it into a cache dir.

@ddtcorex/dsh-maestro-remote README · Settings：Config persists through the **embedded settings store**: a committed, hash-sealed copy of
`dsh-maestro-core`'s store (`src/host/vendor/store.ts`), reading and writing the shared
namespaced document `~/.dsh/dsh-maestro-config/settings.json` through a flat
`MaestroUserConfig` adapter, see `src/host/config-store.ts`. This package does not depend on a
published settings library. Machine runtime state
(`lastTunnelRunning`) deliberately lives in this package's own sidecar
(`~/.dsh/dsh-maestro-remote/runtime.json`) so editing settings can never silently flip
tunnel state.

@ddtcorex/dsh-maestro-remote README · Requirements：- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` and pnpm 11+. A shell that defaults to Node 20 fails with `No such built-in module: node:sqlite`; put a Node 22 `bin` first on `PATH` before running `dsh` or `pnpm`.
- DSH 0.1.x or 0.2.x (peer range `<0.3.0-0`).

@ddtcorex/dsh-maestro-remote README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @ddtcorex/dsh-maestro-remote
```

The package ships its own `cordis.patch.yml`, applied automatically. It includes a
`connection` entry that declares `webServer`, which DSH 0.2.x needs before
`rpc.handle` can register a channel. Do not copy it into the profile patch, and do not
add the rows by hand (duplicate ids crash the loader). Restart `dsh web` after install.

@ddtcorex/dsh-maestro-remote README · Install：To get an exact release instead of whatever the package manager resolves, pin it:
`dsh plugin --profile web add @ddtcorex/dsh-maestro-remote@<version>`.

Installed with `link:` from a checkout? After every `git pull`, run `pnpm install && pnpm build`
(`lib/` is gitignored) and restart `dsh web`.

@ddtcorex/dsh-maestro-remote README · Putting the PIN in front of a tunnel：The proxy listens on port `3081` by default (`proxyPort` in the settings store; it walks up
to 9 ports if that one is busy). A named tunnel whose ingress still points at the raw
`dsh web` port bypasses the PIN, so point the tunnel `service:` at the proxy port instead.
The 8-digit PIN lives in `~/.dsh/dsh-maestro-remote/pin` (created on first use); rotate it
from Settings > Maestro Remote. The PIN cookie lifetime is `pinSessionTtlHours`.
